structured.approach: Read the step skill (DS-03), the two contracted inputs (feat.tasks, feat.design), then checked the ap_forecast checkout myself to confirm the tool view: listed the tracked files, searched for database/SQL/migration usage, and read predict.py, explain.py and models.json. The shell is denied for this step (G9 hook), so I used Glob, Grep and Read instead. The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope, and the DS tasks (TSK-03, TSK-04) are pure in-memory changes. So the output records that no database change is required, lists the evidence, and names re-entry triggers that would bring this check back. No connector was needed, and the step has no verifier gate, so with so few statements I checked them myself rather than delegating.

claims.text: ap_forecast has no database; no migrations exist or are required.

The feature design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope; the data it brings in scope is in-memory (paid_date key, reject reason, delay history, risk map, overdue rows, CT-1 JSON).
DD-1: no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage; only the Python 3.9 standard library and Node.js 22 CommonJS are used.
NF-10: every new function is pure and in-memory, with no I/O, no network and no mutation of inputs.
The Data Science lane's tasks are TSK-03 (vendor_risk in new risk.py, no LLM, no network, no models.json read) and TSK-04 (build_explanation_request gains risk=None; models.json must not change).
ap_forecast modules: new src/ap_forecast/risk.py, additive change to explain.py, __init__.py export and version step; predict.py and models.json unchanged.
The repository contains no SQL, schema or migration files and no match for sqlite, sql, database, migrat, cursor or .connect(.
explain.load_config reads the local static models.json file (provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, max_tokens 300); this is configuration, not a database.
Adding any storage or network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01; the current design triggers none of the DES-01 triggers.

structured.summary: DS-03 is complete: the Data Science lane (ap_forecast, TSK-03 and TSK-04) needs no database change. The design puts storage and migrations out of scope (A1, DD-1, NF-10). The repository has no database, schema or migration files, so there is nothing to complete and no DBA or infrastructure prerequisite. I wrote task.db_changes.md with the evidence and the re-entry triggers that would bring this check back: persisting risk or history, production wiring adding a store (DQ-1), or provider configuration moving to a store (PQ-5, TQ-8). No open questions.

tool_input.description: List tracked files and search for database usage
